major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it close to on cooldown for the burst and the 40% health gain, hold it while you sit on 2 stacks of Voidfall until Fracture pushes you to 3 and you spend them, and fire the free Untethered Rage casts the moment they proc.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 187827 is the Vengeance cast id; 162264 and 200166 share the name and are the Havoc/leap variants. World Killer pulls the effective Annihilator cooldown to roughly 60-80s and Vengeful Beast extends the duration to 20s, so 120/15 are the untalented values.

major_cooldowns.name: Fiery Brand
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it 5 to 10 seconds before Metamorphosis comes off cooldown so Fiery Demise amplifies the Voidfall meteors and the Metamorphosis burst, and cast it whenever you are close to banking 2 charges.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 204021 is the cast; 207771 is the 40% damage reduction aura. Down in Flames cuts the cooldown to 48s and adds a second charge.

major_cooldowns.name: Sigil of Spite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Place it as close to on cooldown as possible for the 3 Soul Fragments, and as Aldrachi Reaver hold it only when a Reaver's Glaive is already stored, since it would be spent activating one you already have.

major_cooldowns.name: Soul Carver
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown at 3 or fewer Soul Fragments so the 6 fragments it shatters do not overcap you.

major_cooldowns.name: Fel Devastation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it at 3 or fewer Soul Fragments and above 85 Fury, lining it up with as many enemies branded by Fiery Brand as you can.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 212084 is the cast id; 212105, 212106, 393831 and 393834 are damage and heal effect ids sharing the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Sigil of Flame
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-place it 1 second before the pull and keep it on cooldown from there, timing each cast so its Fury does not overcap you.

major_cooldowns.name: Immolation Aura
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown, and on 3 or more targets time it so the Fallout fragments do not push you past 6 Soul Fragments; macro it with Infernal Strike since they share a 30 second cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 258920 is the Vengeance cast id; the 4279xx family are per-rank damage effect ids sharing the name.

rule.description: Opener: Sigil of Flame, Metamorphosis, Fiery Brand
rule.action: Pre-place Sigil of Flame 1 second before the pull, then Metamorphosis with Infernal Strike, Fiery Brand, Immolation Aura and Sigil of Spite before you settle into builders.

Keep at least one of the two Demon Spikes charges active at all times against physical damage, and bank the second only when you are heading into downtime with Fiery Brand and Metamorphosis on cooldown.
Press Metamorphosis as soon as Untethered Rage procs; it is free, does not start the cooldown, and the window is only 10 seconds.
Cast Fiery Brand 5 to 10 seconds before Metamorphosis comes off cooldown so Fiery Demise buffs the Mass Acceleration Voidfall stacks and the Dark Matter burst; a partial overlap is enough.

rule.description: Spirit Bomb held for Fiery Brand
rule.action: Hold Spirit Bomb for up to roughly 5 seconds when Fiery Brand is about to land so Fiery Demise amplifies it; otherwise fire it on cooldown at 5 or more Soul Fragments.

rule.description: Sigil of Flame without overcapping Fury
rule.action: Dump into Soul Cleave first when your Fury deficit is 15 or less, then place Sigil of Flame so none of its Fury is lost.
